CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #9
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 120 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which of these shows respect for the differences among people? (1 mark)
   A. Laughing at how others speak
   B. Playing with children from different backgrounds
   C. Giving people nicknames about their bodies
   D. Leaving out children who look different

2. What does Ephesians 4:26 teach about anger? (1 mark)
   A. Do not sin in your anger and do not stay angry for long
   B. Always hit back
   C. Keep anger for a week
   D. Never feel angry

3. A friend invites you to skip class and play. What is the best choice? (1 mark)
   A. Leave school
   B. Tell the teacher a lie
   C. Join him secretly
   D. Politely say no and go to class

4. Whom should you tell if someone touches you in a wrong way? (1 mark)
   A. The person who touched you
   B. A trusted adult such as a parent or teacher
   C. A stranger
   D. Nobody

5. What should you say if someone tries to touch your private parts? (1 mark)
   A. Thank you
   B. No, stop!
   C. Yes please
   D. Nothing

6. Which verse says, "God is love"? (1 mark)
   A. Luke 19:5
   B. 1 John 4:8
   C. Genesis 1:1
   D. Acts 11:26

7. What does "holy" mean? (1 mark)
   A. Old
   B. Rich
   C. Pure, perfect and set apart
   D. Fast

8. Which is a poetry and wisdom book in the Old Testament? (1 mark)
   A. Isaiah
   B. Exodus
   C. Psalms
   D. Joshua

9. Which of these is the correct way to handle the Bible? (1 mark)
   A. Carry it carefully and keep it clean
   B. Sit on it
   C. Draw on its pages
   D. Drop it on the floor

10. Why did people dislike tax collectors? (1 mark)
   A. They were farmers
   B. They were poor
   C. Many took more money than they should
   D. They were teachers

11. What did Zacchaeus promise to give to the poor? (1 mark)
   A. All his possessions
   B. Half of his possessions
   C. One tenth
   D. Nothing

12. What did Samson's set-apart life to God mean he must never do? (1 mark)
   A. Go to Timnah
   B. Visit his parents
   C. Cut his hair
   D. Eat honey

13. What did the seven fat cows stand for? (1 mark)
   A. Seven kings
   B. Seven years of famine
   C. Seven years of plenty
   D. Seven rivers

14. What does the name Abraham point to? (1 mark)
   A. Shepherd
   B. King of Egypt
   C. Father of many nations
   D. Wise man

15. How old was Abram when God changed his name? (1 mark)
   A. 75
   B. 99
   C. 120
   D. 50

16. What was Abram's name changed to? (1 mark)
   A. Israel
   B. Jacob
   C. Abraham
   D. Isaac

17. Who was told about the birth of Jesus in a dream? (1 mark)
   A. Herod
   B. Joseph
   C. Zechariah
   D. Pilate

18. Which angel appeared to Zechariah? (1 mark)
   A. Raphael
   B. Uriel
   C. Gabriel
   D. Michael

19. What was John's main work? (1 mark)
   A. Leading an army
   B. Ruling Israel
   C. Preparing the way for the Lord
   D. Building the temple

20. What did Bartimaeus do after he could see? (1 mark)
   A. He ran to the temple
   B. He followed Jesus
   C. He sold his cloak
   D. He went home to sleep

21. What was Bartimaeus' problem? (1 mark)
   A. He was a leper
   B. He was lame
   C. He was deaf
   D. He was blind

22. How did the crowd treat him at first? (1 mark)
   A. They carried him
   B. They ignored Jesus
   C. They gave him money
   D. They told him to be quiet

23. Which habit helps to prevent many diseases? (1 mark)
   A. Not bathing
   B. Sharing dirty cups
   C. Washing hands with soap
   D. Playing in dirty water

24. In which town did Jesus raise the widow's son? (1 mark)
   A. Cana
   B. Jericho
   C. Nain
   D. Nazareth

25. What does the miracle show about Jesus? (1 mark)
   A. He is only a teacher
   B. He is a weak man
   C. He has power over death
   D. He is a king of Rome

26. What did Jesus pray on the cross? (1 mark)
   A. Father, take me away
   B. Father, send angels
   C. Father, punish them
   D. Father, forgive them

27. What does the lost coin stand for? (1 mark)
   A. A person who has wandered from God
   B. A house
   C. A lamp
   D. A rich man

28. What rests in the branches of the tree? (1 mark)
   A. Goats
   B. Birds
   C. Snakes
   D. Lions

29. What does the seed grow into? (1 mark)
   A. A river
   B. A rock
   C. A small flower
   D. A large tree

30. Which verse tells children to obey parents in the Lord? (1 mark)
   A. John 3:16
   B. Acts 2:38
   C. Genesis 12:1
   D. Ephesians 6:1

31. What should you do if an adult tells you to do something that hurts you? (1 mark)
   A. Obey
   B. Copy it
   C. Refuse and tell a trusted adult
   D. Hide it

32. Which is a way of keeping a uniform in good condition? (1 mark)
   A. Washing and mending it
   B. Leaving it in mud
   C. Tearing it
   D. Lending it out

33. Which is a sin? (1 mark)
   A. Stealing
   B. Praying
   C. Sharing
   D. Helping

34. What does the word holy mean? (1 mark)
   A. Pure and set apart for God
   B. Famous
   C. Rich
   D. Old

35. Who came to Jesus in the temple after the clearing? (1 mark)
   A. Soldiers
   B. Kings
   C. Tax collectors
   D. The blind and the lame

36. Which disciple betrayed Jesus? (1 mark)
   A. Peter
   B. Thomas
   C. Andrew
   D. Judas Iscariot

37. Who replaced Judas among the twelve? (1 mark)
   A. Paul
   B. Barnabas
   C. Stephen
   D. Matthias

38. What did Stephen see before he died? (1 mark)
   A. A lion
   B. A storm
   C. Heaven open and Jesus standing at God's right hand
   D. Nothing

39. Why does the prayer use "our" and "us"? (1 mark)
   A. Only for adults
   B. It is a mistake
   C. We pray together and for others
   D. Only for priests

40. What does Philippians 4:8 encourage us to think about? (1 mark)
   A. Whatever is unkind
   B. Whatever is false
   C. Whatever is true, pure and lovely
   D. Whatever hurts

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
41. Explain how knowing that God is holy should affect the way a child behaves. (5 marks)

42. Give three ways of avoiding situations that lead to sin. (3 marks)

43. Describe four steps you can follow when you feel very angry with someone. (4 marks)

44. Name two digital devices used at home or school. (2 marks)

45. Explain what "born again" means. (2 marks)

46. Explain how children can help the needy at school, at home and in church. (5 marks)

47. State three reasons why we should pray every day. (3 marks)

48. Describe what a child should do step by step if someone touches them wrongly. (4 marks)

49. Give three ways in which a child can protect themselves from sexual abuse. (3 marks)

50. Give three ways of showing respect to family members. (3 marks)

51. Explain what the Lord's Prayer teaches about forgiveness and protection. (5 marks)

52. Explain three ways in which children can show God's love to others. (3 marks)

53. Give two examples of personal information that you should not share online. (2 marks)

54. State two ways of showing respect for the Bible. (2 marks)

55. List three school rules and give a reason for each. (3 marks)

56. Why was the widow of Nain in great need? (2 marks)

57. Write John 3:16 in your own words and explain what it teaches. (4 marks)

58. Give two reasons why Zacchaeus climbed the sycamore-fig tree. (2 marks)

59. State three things that show that Nicodemus changed. (3 marks)
pages.answers:
CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #9 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. B — Playing with children from different backgrounds
   Respecting differences shows that we value all of God's creation.

2. A — Do not sin in your anger and do not stay angry for long
   The verse says that we should not sin when angry and should settle it quickly.

3. D — Politely say no and go to class
   Skipping class is wrong and harms learning.

4. B — A trusted adult such as a parent or teacher
   A trusted adult can protect you.

5. B — No, stop!
   Say no loudly and clearly, then move away.

6. B — 1 John 4:8
   1 John 4:8 states that God is love.

7. C — Pure, perfect and set apart
   God is holy because He never does wrong.

8. C — Psalms
   Psalms, Proverbs and Job are among the poetry and wisdom books.

9. A — Carry it carefully and keep it clean
   We respect the Bible because it is God's word.

10. C — Many took more money than they should
   Many tax collectors cheated people.

11. B — Half of his possessions
   Zacchaeus said he would give half of his possessions.

12. C — Cut his hair
   A Nazirite did not cut his hair.

13. C — Seven years of plenty
   Joseph explained that they were seven good years.

14. C — Father of many nations
   God said that he would be a father of many nations.

15. B — 99
   Genesis 17:1 says he was ninety-nine.

16. C — Abraham
   Genesis 17:5 records the new name.

17. B — Joseph
   Matthew 1:20 says an angel appeared to Joseph in a dream.

18. C — Gabriel
   Gabriel said, "I stand in the presence of God."

19. C — Preparing the way for the Lord
   Luke 1:76 says he would prepare the way.

20. B — He followed Jesus
   Mark 10:52 says he followed Jesus along the road.

21. D — He was blind
   Bartimaeus was a blind beggar.

22. D — They told him to be quiet
   Many rebuked him and told him to be quiet.

23. C — Washing hands with soap
   Clean hands prevent the spread of germs.

24. C — Nain
   Luke 7:11 says Nain.

25. C — He has power over death
   Jesus is Lord of life.

26. D — Father, forgive them
   Luke 23:34 records this prayer.

27. A — A person who has wandered from God
   The coin stands for a lost person.

28. B — Birds
   The birds perched in its branches.

29. D — A large tree
   The seed grew and became a tree.

30. D — Ephesians 6:1
   Ephesians 6:1 says this.

31. C — Refuse and tell a trusted adult
   Obedience is only for good instructions.

32. A — Washing and mending it
   Good care extends its life.

33. A — Stealing
   Stealing is taking what is not yours.

34. A — Pure and set apart for God
   Holy means pure and set apart.

35. D — The blind and the lame
   Matthew 21:14 says He healed them.

36. D — Judas Iscariot
   Judas betrayed Jesus.

37. D — Matthias
   Acts 1:26 says Matthias was chosen.

38. C — Heaven open and Jesus standing at God's right hand
   Acts 7:55-56.

39. C — We pray together and for others
   The prayer reminds us to think of others.

40. C — Whatever is true, pure and lovely
   Philippians 4:8.

SECTION B
----
41. (5 marks)
   Answer: God is pure and never does wrong, so we should respect Him, worship Him and try to be holy. We should choose good things, tell the truth, avoid sin, behave well in church and obey His commandments. If we fail, we should say sorry.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for God being holy, 1 for respect, 1 for choosing good, 1 for avoiding sin or obeying, 1 for saying sorry.

42. (3 marks)
   Answer: Choose good friends, avoid wrong places, be careful about what you watch, keep busy with good things, pray.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each way.

43. (4 marks)
   Answer: Stop and breathe, count to ten, walk away if needed, tell a trusted adult, pray, forgive and make peace.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid step, up to 4.

44. (2 marks)
   Answer: Phone, tablet, computer, TV, radio.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

45. (2 marks)
   Answer: A new spiritual birth, a fresh start given by God through the Holy Spirit.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for new life and 1 for the Holy Spirit.

46. (5 marks)
   Answer: School: share a pencil or lunch, help a struggling classmate. Home: help with chores, give clothes that still fit. Church: take part in collections, visit the sick with parents.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each of school, home and church, and 2 marks for clear explanations.

47. (3 marks)
   Answer: We can thank God; ask for help; grow spiritually; know God better; get strength to avoid wrong.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each reason.

48. (4 marks)
   Answer: Say no loudly, move away quickly to a safe place with people, shout for help if needed, tell a trusted adult right away even if told to keep it secret.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid step, up to 4.

49. (3 marks)
   Answer: Say no loudly, run away, do not accept gifts from strangers, avoid being alone in hidden places, tell a trusted adult.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid way.

50. (3 marks)
   Answer: Greet politely, obey, help with chores, speak kindly, share, pray for them.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid way, up to 3.

51. (5 marks)
   Answer: We ask God to forgive us as we forgive others, so we must forgive. We ask Him to lead us away from temptation and to deliver us from evil, so we depend on His protection and try to avoid wrong.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for God's forgiveness, 1 for forgiving others, 1 for temptation, 1 for evil, 1 for depending on God.

52. (3 marks)
   Answer: Share, help the sick, forgive, speak kindly, include others.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each way.

53. (2 marks)
   Answer: Home address, school, phone number, passwords, family photos.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

54. (2 marks)
   Answer: Keep it clean, carry it carefully, keep it in a high safe place, wash hands before reading, do not write in it.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid way.

55. (3 marks)
   Answer: Arrive on time, so lessons are not disturbed; keep quiet in class, so all can learn; do not fight, so all are safe.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each rule with a reason.

56. (2 marks)
   Answer: She had lost her husband and now her only son, so she had nobody to provide for her.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the husband and 1 for the son.

57. (4 marks)
   Answer: God loved the world so much that He gave His only Son so that everyone who believes in Him will not be lost but will have eternal life. It teaches God's love and the way to eternal life.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for God's love, 1 for giving Jesus, 1 for believing, 1 for eternal life.

58. (2 marks)
   Answer: He was short, the crowd was big, and he wanted to see Jesus.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid reason.

59. (3 marks)
   Answer: He defended Jesus fairly; he brought spices for Jesus' burial; he showed courage.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid sign.
